A new Fighter starts with four items: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing and Torchx5**. The last one is probably a bug, because the code comment says "Rations".

**Where it's defined:** `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65-72`. The Fighter entry is `[2, 15, 17, 23]`. `grantStartingEquipment()` (`character.ts:74`) is called from character creation at line 59. It inserts each ID into `character_inventory` with quantity 1 and `equipped = 0`, so nothing starts equipped.

**ID-to-name mapping:** `worker/src/db/seed.sql:4-41`. Item IDs come from insert order in the `items` table.

| ID | Item |
|---|---|
| 2 | Longsword (weapon, 1d8, +2 attack) |
| 15 | Shield (armor, +2 AC) |
| 17 | Potion of Healing (heals 2d4+2) |
| 23 | Torchx5 (misc) |

**Mismatch:** the comment at `character.ts:66` says ID 23 is "Rations", but in `seed.sql` ID 23 is `Torchx5`. "Rations (1 day)" is ID 24, which is also what the shop seed uses at `seed.sql:134`. The Wizard, Cleric and Bard entries use 23 with the same "Rations" comment, so they have the same problem. The Ranger (22, Rope) and Rogue (25, Thieves Tools) entries are correct. I haven't changed anything, since this was read-only.
